blocks.text: Riot Games has announced the return of League of Legends’ virtual group HEARTSTEEL with their new single “Live My Life” (Riot Games/Virgin Music Group), out now. The track marks the group’s first release since their 2023 breakout debut single, “PARANOIA,” which has amassed over 200M streams across all platforms. HEARTSTEEL is the all-male pop collective in the growing roster of groundbreaking virtual artists within the iconic League of Legends IP. This group of dynamic daredevils reimagines beloved in-game champions as pop-stars: Ezreal (vocalist), Kayn (rapper), Aphelios (instrumentalist, songwriter), Yone (producer), K’Sante (co-leader, vocalist), and Sett (co-leader, rapper).
